log_file.description: Path to log file. Leave empty to log only to stderr.

max_concurrent_accounts.description: Maximum number of accounts to sync in parallel.

max_connections_per_account.description: Max simultaneous connections per account (for parallel folder sync).

retry_delay.description: Seconds to wait before retrying a failed connection or operation.

dry_run.description: If enabled, simulate sync without modifying any mailboxes.

verbose.description: Enable verbose debug output, including raw IMAP commands/responses.

qresync.description: Require QRESYNC capability for fast resynchronization. Recommended for production.

validate_uidvalidity.description: Refuse to sync if UIDVALIDITY has changed (prevents data corruption).

temp_state_ttl.description: Lifetime (seconds) of temporary sync state before cleanup.

state_dir.description: Directory to store temporary state files (e.g., UIDs, timestamps). Must be writable by interimap.

tls_ca_bundle.description: Optional path to custom CA bundle for TLS verification.

accounts.description: List of IMAP accounts to sync. Each entry defines a sync pair (source ↔ destination).

name.description: Unique name for this account configuration.

source_host.description: IMAP hostname of the source server.

source_port.description: IMAP port of the source server (typically 993 for SSL, 143 for STARTTLS).

source_user.description: Username (login) for the source IMAP account.

source_use_ssl.description: Use SSL (implicit TLS) on the source server.

source_tls.description: Use STARTTLS on the source server (ignored if source_use_ssl is true).

source_skip_tls_verify.description: ⚠️ Skip TLS certificate verification on source (insecure — use only for testing).

dest_host.description: IMAP hostname of the destination server.

dest_port.description: IMAP port of the destination server.

dest_user.description: Username (login) for the destination IMAP account.

dest_use_ssl.description: Use SSL (implicit TLS) on the destination server.

dest_tls.description: Use STARTTLS on the destination server (ignored if dest_use_ssl is true).

dest_skip_tls_verify.description: ⚠️ Skip TLS certificate verification on destination (insecure).

direction.description: Sync direction. Use 'both' for bidirectional sync.

folder_prefix.description: Optional prefix to prepend to folder names on the destination (e.g., 'Backup/' for migration).

folder_patterns.description: Folder filtering patterns. '+' for include, '-' for exclude (glob-style, e.g., ['+INBOX.*', '-*Trash*']).

folder_mapping.description: Manual mapping of source folder names to destination folder names.

batch_size.description: Maximum messages to process per folder per batch.

concurrent_folder_sync.description: Max folders to sync in parallel per account.

flag_sync.description: Which side’s flags to sync. 'both' preserves flags from both sides.

ignore_flags.description: List of flag names to ignore (e.g., ['\Recent', '\Seen']).
